$comment: Default field values for the 'internal' security profile. See marin-digital-standards/security/profiles.md for the prose explanation. A new app's security.json starts from the matching profile file here, then fills in app-specific fields (data, authentication, exceptions, review, publicSecurity) — this file only carries what's true by default for every app choosing this profile.

contentTypeOptions.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

permissionsPolicy.notes: GitHub Pages does not serve custom HTTP response headers.

frameProtection.notes: Requires a header (X-Frame-Options) or a directive meta-delivered CSP ignores (frame-ancestors); neither is available on GitHub Pages.
